description: This is a Perl script for flashing firmware to a D-Link DSL-G6x4T device via network. The script scans for the device, establishes an FTP connection, retrieves partition information, and uploads firmware content to specific memory regions before rebooting the device.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP with added methods for retrieving environment variables and rebooting the device, tailored for the ADAM2 device via FTP commands.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends a USER command for FTP login.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves an environment variable from the device via the GETENV FTP command.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get environment variables using _GETENV.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Sends the REBOOT command to the device via FTP.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Public method to reboot the device.
